propositions: Four independent Mypy safety settings (no_implicit_optional, strict_equality, warn_redundant_casts, warn_unused_ignores) must be enabled after revalidating existing diagnostics.
Ruff ASYNC and DTZ rule families must be enabled after making three timezone-related sites explicit and establishing a shared ratchet test.
Function complexity (C901) must be enforced with a symbol-level shrink-only baseline at threshold 15 integrated into the lint gate.
RUF hygiene rule family (excluding RUF001/002/003) must be enabled after clearing approved RUF100 and other resolved diagnostics.

All newly-enforced gates (complexity, mypy, Ruff ASYNC/DTZ, RUF) must exit zero against the current origin/main tip before landing, and any pre-existing ratchet-family diagnostics must be resolved or captured in baseline.

Child stories must be delivered independently into a feature branch (or directly to main per Gerrit workflow) with pyproject.toml edits ordered as d9f5, then 28cd, then 125d, with 28cd creating and 125d extending the shared ratchet test.
